scope: Unit batch-3 protocol research draft (task-24). Proposal only: not merged into platform/units/catalog.json and not runtime admission. Entries mirror the existing catalog entry shape; evidence URLs are official product pages, the official I2C address index and official m5stack/uiflow-micropython drivers anchored at snapshot 528edd8 (V2.1.5). All defaults are synthetic test-fixture values.

units.name: Unit VMeter

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: ADS1115 0x49: conversion 0x00 int16be, config 0x01 (OS bit15, mode bit8, rate bits7:5, PGA bits11:9); EEPROM 0x53 device-local calibration blocks at 208/216/224/232/240/248 (8B: gain, expect BE16, real BE16, XOR). Driver voltage = resolution(gain)*calibration*conversion*(-1) with divider coefficient 0.015918958.
gaps: Real factory calibration layout comes from the driver only; fixtures are synthetic.
0x53 conflicts with registered accel (U056) and 0x49/0x53 must be checked on the bus.
Isolation, ±36V measurement range, fuse and 1% accuracy are NOT RUN.

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to two device-local slaves (ADS1115 0x49 + read-only EEPROM 0x53) attached to one Grove pair

units.blocker: 参数化复用 0126 ameter 双从机模式：ADS1115 0x49 config/conversion 由 voltage-v 按驱动 gain/rate 与 0.015918958 分压系数反算；EEPROM 0x53 为合成校验合法记录（factor 1.0）且默认只读。未采集 guest/Device Service 证据，保持 planned。真实出厂校准、±36V/隔离/保险丝、1% 精度 NOT RUN；0x53 与 accel 冲突（一总线一个）。
units.input_semantics: Synthetic voltage fixture inverse-encoded into the ADS1115 conversion register; EEPROM record is synthetic but checksum-valid.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest config/conversion transactions and rejected EEPROM writes; voltage is guest-side driver output.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Real factory calibration coefficients are unavailable; fixtures are synthetic. Isolation, ±36V range and 1% accuracy are NOT RUN.

units.name: Unit ADC

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: ADS1100 at 0x48: 1-byte config write (bit7 ST/BSY, bit4 SC, bits3:2 DR, bits1:0 PGA); conversion read returns 3 bytes [data_hi, data_lo, config]; rates (128,32,16,8) SPS, gains (1,2,4,8); driver default config 0x8C and voltage=(value/(-min_code[rate]*gain))*3.3*4.

0x48 conflicts with adc-v11 and ameter (one Unit per bus).

units.name: Unit ENV-IV

BMP280 at 0x76 as existing US_BMP280 (0xD0=0x58, 0x88 calibration 24B, 0xF7 data 6B).

The snapshot driver/sht4x.py has broken getters (self.measure[0/1] without call); master fixes them, so the implementation must pin the master SHA.
ENVUnit requires an explicit type argument (type=4); no auto-detection.
Product page is EOL.

units.name: Unit CO2

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SCD4x at 0x62: 2-byte big-endian commands, responses are 2-byte words each followed by CRC8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). Key commands: start periodic 0x21B1, stop 0x3F86, low-power 0x21AC, data-ready 0xE4B8, read measurement 0xEC05 (CO2/T/RH), reinit 0x3646, factory reset 0x3632, temp offset 0x241D/0x2318, altitude 0x2427/0x2322, pressure 0xE000, serial 0x3682, self-test 0x3639, single-shot 0x219D/0x2196, power down 0x36E0, wake 0x36F6.
gaps: The product page/driver say SCD40 while the official I2C index lists SCD41 @0x62; chip identity is UNRESOLVED.
The snapshot driver is an asyncio implementation while master rewrote it as a synchronous command layer; API and timing differ, so one SHA must be pinned.
5s periodic-measurement timing, CO2 accuracy and calibration behavior are NOT RUN.

claims: async SCD40 implementation in the snapshot; rewritten to sync on master

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local SCD4x slave at 0x62 implementing the command + CRC-word protocol

units.blocker: 新增 US_SCD40（0x62）：命令 2B BE + 每 2B 数据后 CRC8(poly 0x31, init 0xFF) 词协议；实现 0x21B1/0x3F86/0x21AC 周期测量、0xE4B8 就绪、0xEC05 测量（9B）、0x241D/0x2318 温度偏移、0x2427/0x2322 海拔、0xE000 压力、0x3682 序列号、0x3646/0x3632 复位等；测量值由 fixture 编码。未采集 guest/Device Service 证据，保持 planned。SCD40 vs SCD41 芯片冲突、快照 async vs master sync 两套实现需钉 SHA；5s 周期/CRC/精度 NOT RUN。
units.input_semantics: Synthetic CO2/temperature/humidity/readiness fixtures encoded into CRC-valid SCD4x response words.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest command words, CRC words and measurement reads; gas-sensor physics are not modeled.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.

units.name: Unit PbHub

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: PbHub at 0x61 (0x61-0x68 via A0-A2): six channel base addresses [0x40,0x50,0x60,0x70,0x80,0xA0]; per-channel command offsets: 0x00/0x01 digital write IO0/IO1, 0x02/0x03 analog write IO0/IO1, 0x04/0x05 digital read IO0/IO1, 0x06 analog read (2B LE), 0x07 reserve, 0x08 RGB num (2B LE), 0x09 one-LED color (2B LE pos + 3B color), 0x0A range color (2B+2B LE + 3B color), 0x0B brightness; hub 0xFE firmware / 0xFF address.

registers.encoding: per-channel command matrix (0x00-0x0B offsets per channel base)

gaps: MCU identity conflicts across documents: product page description says MEGA328, specifications table says STM32F030F4P6, official I2C index says MEGA328.
RGB 3-byte order differs between snapshot (big-endian) and master (GRB swap); one SHA must be pinned.
Hub nesting is not supported; channel addresses overlap registered Units (encoder/scroll 0x40, nfc/acssr 0x50, dac 0x60, env-iii 0x70) and must only be exposed through this hub attachment.
10-bit 0-5V analog mapping, PWM/servo/RGB electrical behavior are NOT RUN.

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a multi-address hub attachment: 0x61 config slave + six channel slaves at 0x40/0x50/0x60/0x70/0x80/0xA0

units.output_semantics: Observed guest per-channel command writes and hub address/config traffic; no servo/RGB electrical behavior.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.

units.name: Unit Tube Pressure

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: White analog output 0.1-3.1V maps -100..200 kPa; driver reads ADC ATTN_11DB: pressure=(v-0.1)/3.0*300-100 kPa, voltage=v, analog value averages 10 samples trimming min/max (16-bit or 12-bit).

units.name: Unit Ultrasonic-IO

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Driver: trigger yellow high 10us then low; echo white pulse width measured by machine.time_pulse_us(echo, 1, timeout_us); distance mm = pulse_us*100//582 (= pulse_us*0.1718), cm = mm/10; 50ms between measurements. Page claims 2-450cm, 40kHz, ±2%, 50ms cycle.
gaps: Product-page PinMap labels PORT.A as SDA/SCL while the driver and description use GPIO trigger/echo; the labels are unresolved.
RCWL-9620 timing (>3.5m delayed response, 50ms cycle), temperature compensation and ±2% accuracy are NOT RUN.
time_pulse_us high-level timeout semantics must be matched exactly in the model.

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC GPIO: observe the guest trigger pulse on yellow and generate a corresponding echo pulse on white so machine.time_pulse_us() measures it

units.blocker: 新增 GPIO id 'ultrasonic-io'：黄线通过 pad observer 观测 guest 触发（拉高 ≥10us），在触发沿后用 QEMU 定时器按 distance-mm 生成白线回波脉宽 pulse_us=distance_mm*582/100，超时路径保持低电平。未采集 guest/Device Service 证据，保持 planned。页面 PinMap 的 SDA/SCL 标签与 GPIO 事实冲突；声学/温度补偿/±2% 精度与 >3.5m 延迟 NOT RUN；time_pulse_us 超时语义需与 MicroPython 对齐。
units.input_semantics: Synthetic target-distance fixture drives a model-generated echo pulse width on the white wire; timeout fixture covers the no-echo path.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest trigger pulses and model echo pulses; distance is guest-side driver output.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Ultrasonic acoustics, temperature compensation and ±2% accuracy are not modeled.
